_comment: Tests that may not disappear. test/required-tests.sh runs every name listed
here and fails when one is missing, skipped or red.
A regression test is the only thing standing between a fixed defect and its
return, and it is deleted by the same edit that reintroduces the defect — so
the suite goes green over the regression and nothing reports it. Listing a
name here moves it out of reach of that edit: removing the test now means
removing it from this file too, which is a line a reviewer sees.
The list is deliberately short. It is for gates whose removal is silent and
expensive — authorization, encryption and squashing decisions — not for
coverage in general, which is what the ordinary unit suite is for.
Names are top-level Go test functions. A subtest is not addressable here: a
test keeps its name while its cases are hollowed out, so a name in this file
Adding one: name a test that already exists and passes on develop, or the
check goes red on the pull request that adds it.
JSON with jq, matching test/conformance/suites.json, so a runner needs
